title: Hotel Sacher Vienna: Das Sacher & Sachertorte Guide
description: Hotel Sacher Wien, home of the original Sachertorte, was filmed for the TV drama Das Sacher and gave its name to a 1939 film.
h1: Hotel Sacher Vienna: the hotel of the original Sachertorte
intro: Behind the Vienna State Opera, the Hotel Sacher is known for a chocolate cake and a very theatrical history. Both have been on screen.
filming: The 2016 Austrian-German two-part drama Das Sacher tells the story of Anna Sacher, the widow of the hotel's founder, around 1900. A report says it was filmed in the Hotel Sacher itself. The hotel also gave its name to a 1939 film, Hotel Sacher.
facts: Eduard Sacher founded the hotel in 1876, and his wife Anna ran it after he died in 1892.
The Sachertorte is credited to Eduard's father Franz Sacher, who is said to have created it for a reception given by Chancellor Metternich.
After years of litigation with the confectioner Demel, only the Sacher dessert may be marketed as the Original Sachertorte.
The hotel stands in Vienna's first district, behind the State Opera.
visit: Try the Sachertorte in the hotel's café, and book a room early for the opera season. Vienna's Ringstrasse sights are within walking distance.
